title: Commuting Graph of Unitriangular Group UT(4; p)
summary: Let G = UT(4; p) be the group of all 4 ? 4 unitriangular matrices over the fi?nite fi?eld Fp, where p is a prime. Using the six-parameter form of the elements of G, we describe the commutativity relation explicitly and use it to analyse the struc- ture of the graph. We prove that the reduced commuting graph is connected and has diameter 3. We also determine the size of its maximal cliques, chromatic number, independence number, per- fectness, etc. by decomposing the graph into cosets, layers, and direction parts.
